title: Git Namespaces — Adopt Repository — payload
description: Brings a repository that already exists on the forge under the VTC's governance and names its owners. Used for repositories created outside the VTC, and to complete a repository reserved by git-ns/repo/create in a namespace where a person had to create it.

owners.description: The DIDs to record as owners (`git.repo.own`). At least one: a repository always has an owner.

Response.title: Git Namespaces — Adopt Repository — response payload

repo.description: The repository as recorded after adoption.
